summary: Phase 149O.20L.7O.2 -- RepositoryIdentity Creation on Dell + DeploymentBinding Field Resolution / Proposition Drafting. FINAL VERDICT: REPOSITORYIDENTITY CREATION FAILED -- NO STATE CHANGE. Ran full local entry checks (pcae health/check/status coherence/doctor task-memory/push check/runtime inspect/notify status/phase-report show+reconcile), confirmed zero authority-bearing drift between the deployed candidate SHA (b0840e96a7ffb12308e95828aa5927c3e7c770c0) and Mac HEAD across src/pcae/**, scripts/**, docs/contracts/**, schemas/**, pyproject.toml. Independently reconstructed the RepositoryIdentity creation command from source (repository_identity.py) rather than the governing prompt; confirmed no identity-only CLI subcommand exists (pcae init also runs unrelated template-file writes and hook installation), so the narrowest safe operation is a direct, out-of-band ensure_repository_identity(HarnessPath.cwd()) call using the unmodified production module. Determined the correct executing principal is the pcae OS principal (uid 1004, dedicated nologin system account), not codex or root, per 7O.1's own finding and independently re-confirmed via live topology (codex cannot even read /opt/pcae/runtime/src; /etc/passwd names pcae as 'PCAE agent principal'). Ran a fresh, read-only Dell preflight as the pcae principal: machine-id, hostname, source SHA, detached-HEAD state, git cleanliness, HMIC implementation_scope_digest (65ff8ab06b5cd7feb2505742cfbb112ffd386c5b2cf34c2d7f3446d92afe15b8), RepositoryIdentity absence, DeploymentBinding/trust-store absence, and path safety (no symlinks anywhere in the .pcae/ ancestor chain) all confirmed exact matches to the expected entering baseline. One discrepancy independently found and disclosed: the live 39-check HBDC aggregator also reports HBDC-REQ-036 (no_configured_production_launcher_detected) as False, a second, pre-existing, unrelated residual not named as such by the phase brief's 'sole residual' framing. Independently derived the exact target path (/opt/pcae/runtime/src/.pcae/repository-identity.json) and confirmed path safety. Executed the single authorized mutation -- ensure_repository_identity(root) via sudo -n -u pcae -- which raised PermissionError on tempfile.mkstemp, the very first write inside the atomic-write path: .pcae/ is root-owned, group pcae, mode 750, giving the pcae principal read+traverse but not write on that directory -- a real-host directory-permission provisioning gap, not a defect in repository_identity.py's logic (which behaved correctly: fail-closed, atomic, zero partial state). Per governing constraint, did not immediately retry; instead inspected state directly and confirmed nothing was persisted (no identity file, no stray '.tmp-repository-identity-*' file). Deliberately rejected escalating to root to force the write through, for two independently sufficient reasons: (a) a root-owned, 0600-mode file (the module's own no-chmod default) would be unreadable by the pcae principal that every real downstream consumer (HBDC diagnostic, HMIC identity resolver, HATP producers) runs as, silently converting 'absent' into 'present but unreadable'; (b) fixing the underlying directory permission is itself an unauthorized mutation under this phase's own mutation wall (only 'first RepositoryIdentity creation' was authorized). Re-verified all invariants post-failure: HMIC digest unchanged, HEAD SHA unchanged, git status unchanged (clean), HBDC diagnostic result unchanged (still no_repository_identity_present), trust-store still empty. DeploymentBinding field resolution and proposition drafting were correctly not reached, gated on a repository_id value that was never produced; 7O.1's independent finding that principal_id/signer_key_id/provider_profile/authority_scope remain unresolvable (empty production trust-store registry, no canonical source) stands, unaffected and orthogonal to this phase's own finding. No DeploymentBinding, election, CHGR, certification, Boundary C, Boundary A, HATP activation, or any other Dell mutation of any kind was performed or attempted. Recommends a dedicated, narrow, human-governed administrative phase to remediate the .pcae/ directory-permission gap on hac-dell before RepositoryIdentity creation is re-attempted with the same, already-correct command.
